SELECT t2.final_result, AVG(t1.total_clicks) FROM (SELECT id_student, code_module, code_presentation, SUM(sum_click) AS total_clicks FROM studentVle WHERE code_presentation = '2014J' GROUP BY id_student, code_module, code_presentation) AS t1 JOIN studentInfo AS t2 ON t1.id_student = t2.id_student AND t1.code_module = t2.code_module AND t1.code_presentation = t2.code_presentation GROUP BY t2.final_result
